unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U24: Choose the enforcement route and reconcile sale proceeds

payload.title: A mortgage is not a universal private-sale power
payload.core_explanation_md:
Section69 has limited qualifying categories and conditions for sale without court intervention. Express power, location or the specified mortgage/party category may matter, along with the statutory default and notice conditions. Do not infer a private-sale right from any mortgage label. SARFAESI is a distinct route with its own creditor, asset, registration and procedural requirements.

The court mortgage process distinguishes preliminary and final decrees. For sale proceeds, the source describes prior-encumbrance treatment, proper sale costs, the mortgage obligations and the residue for the entitled person. Keep a transparent reconciliation rather than treating all realisations as bank income. The textbook blanket SARFAESI amount shorthand is not a substitute for the complete eligibility/exclusion analysis.

self_check.prompt_text: Does every mortgage permit sale without court intervention under section 69?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Qualifying categories and conditions must be established.

payload.stem_md: A recovery officer assumes section 69 permits private sale under every mortgage simply because the loan defaulted. What is missing?

options.explanation_md: Valuation alone does not establish the power.

options.text_md: A rule that default cancels all procedural safeguards
options.explanation_md: Default alone does not establish a qualifying section 69 category or satisfy the statutory exercise conditions.
Preference does not establish statutory power.

options.text_md: The qualifying category, power and statutory exercise conditions

payload.stem_md: A sale surplus remains after the stated prior claims, proper costs and secured dues. The lender treats it as extra interest without a basis. What is required?

options.explanation_md: The source describes a residue entitlement.

options.text_md: Reconcile and pay the residue to the entitled person under the applicable rule
options.explanation_md: Sale realisation is not unrestricted lender income.
Proper costs are part of the stated order.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Sale realisation is not unrestricted lender income.
